prompt:
Create ONE cinematic CHARACTER INTRODUCTION ILLUSTRATION for the original Japanese shisha-crafting visual novel SUIEN ZENSEN. Wide LANDSCAPE 16:9 full-screen illustration intended for a 1280x720 game stage. Exactly one human character; no streamer facecam, no additional right-side character, no duplicate portrait, no UI buttons. This is the graphic artwork layer only: NO LETTERS, WORDS, JAPANESE TEXT, NUMBERS, LOGOS or pseudo-text anywhere. We will place editable Japanese typography over the quiet right side later.

REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is the just-remastered sprite of THIS character, the authority for his recognisable face, hairstyle, accessories, actual clothing and personality. Image 2 is its unretouched native face crop for identity. Image 3 is our current Claude-built introduction screen: use only its broad relationship of ONE big character on the LEFT, a diagonal color sweep behind the middle, and a generous RIGHT area for a name and a bottom-right quote. Do not copy its old portrait, existing text, typography or exact artwork. Image 4 is an approved Minto sprite used ONLY as a game-wide rendering quality reference: crisp delicate outlines, carefully stepped anime shading, dense fine detail, controlled specular highlights, no coarse pixel mosaic, no blurry airbrush.

A striking Japanese game introduction splash with a bold ink-and-screenprint graphic feel, lively diagonal geometry, limited accent color against soot black and warm ivory, subtle halftone and torn paper texture, and curling shisha smoke integrated as an elegant graphic motif. Inspired by the dramatic introduction-screen energy of Danganronpa, but use our own shisha-craft setting, character colors, props and composition; no school insignia, blood splashes, bullet motifs, mascot bear, character logos or copy of a particular screen.

COMPOSITION: the character's expressive face and shoulders dominate the LEFT HALF, face centered near x=28%, y=27%; fully retain the hair/hat above the head with top margin. Show head through waist/hips, confident slightly three-quarter pose and visible hands where appropriate. Main character and all important face/hand details stay to the LEFT of x=54%. Keep x=57% to 96%, y=24% to 72% dark and visually QUIET enough for a big white Japanese name, a smaller surname and an upper title. Keep x=54% to 96%, y=78% to 93% quiet for a quote. A wide restrained diagonal accent band sweeps through the middle BEHIND the character and future name, accompanied by one thin ivory parallel line. Graphic fragments, low-contrast motif silhouettes and expressive smoke mostly decorate the left edge, top-right outer corner and lower-left, not the lettering zones. No frame that cuts into the portrait, no speech bubble.

Render the man as the SAME person in the remastered sprite, in its premium fine anime sprite quality with subtly more cinematic, crisp shadow shapes. Do not invent a new outfit, age, face, hairstyle or beard. Keep natural adult anatomy and expressive characterisation. The background is full opaque artwork, not a transparent cutout. No text.

HAJIME — age 22, friendly ordinary Japanese young man, exactly the face in the black-cap reference. Short softly messy black hair, black baseball cap with only its tiny existing abstract steam mark, blue-grey/dark eyes, gentle honest confident little smile. Black oversized zip hoodie over black tee, slim silver mouthpiece pendant, dark casual streetwear. Relaxed approachable posture, one hand loosely offered near his waist as if welcoming a customer, other hand near a pocket. Do not put him in an apron or white tee from old descriptions. ACCENT warm amber GOLD / ivory / ink black. Motifs: abstract three-strand smoke, faint silhouette of a normal shisha stem and round glass base, gentle diagonal rising steam: promise of a young cafe worker. No fake new logos. A slightly more direct gaze and open expression than the reference but retain the same young face.
